criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1 and 2 meet the bar; 2 the best image, the 74 percent reads at 432 px. 6, 7 and 9 competent staged scenes, kit people as mannequins. Frame 5 a grey slab with stair-stepped cast. Frame 8 figure slumped, wheel with nobody behind it, flat greys, rules crossing the dek band. Frame 3 leaders cross, ITE dot on its own label. Frame 4 lone car in front of full rows.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One lot under one key, the stripe a single-meaning seam, the camera move works. 5 the greyest frame in a black deck; 8 visually foreign; paint drifts blue-grey on 6 and 9.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, verbatim quotes, computations check, freight statements attributed and never joined to roster rows. Slide 8's Permian line looser than c68; slide 8's image can read as an inattentive observer.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: State list, concentration, free and never expiring authorization, Dallas refused, enforcement line, a route for a concern. The Legislature through SB 2807 appears only as a hashtag; the caption question gives no route or timing.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, turn at 5 to 7, close lands on an action. Frame 4 cuttable; frame 8 a detour.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, precise, strong plain hooks; reads like a careful clerk; the truncated company name three times; agency diction on 7.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Subject and car-as-unit device new against 71 to 74, but fourth AV deck in 30 days, no. 52's lot-of-robotaxis move, no. 67's Charger lane, kit crossover and staged lastLight with dusk_gold used in 66, caption closes on a question like 71 and 73.

one_sentence_fix: Re-stage frame 8 so the person sits behind the wheel head up, and rebuild frame 5 as a bright steel rule with a tall stop block on a near-black mat.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mid-grey plate with ribbed grey stripes above, stair-stepped cast, a grey rectangle with ticks at 432 px.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A narrow, brightly keyed steel bar on a near-black mat, drop the ribbed band, taller stop block with a long smooth cast, grooves running out at the right edge as the brightest thing.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Figure slumped looking at the lap, wheel on the right with no one behind it, flat greys, mannequin.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Passenger-side camera with the wheel in front of the seated person, head raised, hands at the rim, side-glass key on face and hands, road and seam through the windshield.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Leader lines cross, ITE dot on its own label, which run belongs to which company unclear.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pin each label at the head of its own run beside its divider without crossing leaders.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Lone car in front of full rows, bays and stops only at lower right.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera at the empty end of the row so nine open bays with lit stops lead back to the single car.
